t.PANTHENOL.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.PANTHENOL.eff.0: No known side effect in normal use (CIR, 2022).
t.PANTHENOL.summary: A precursor of vitamin B5; a skin and hair conditioning agent.
t.PANTHENOL.what: Keeps skin and hair moist and soft, and reduces static in hair.
